_comment: Surviving bin/value-mutants.mjs mutants that are equivalent by construction: no input, reachable or not, makes the mutated base.js compute a different result. Key: <file>#<fingerprint of the operator, the condition or statement holding the mutant, and the mutated expression>:<operator>[@<n>]. The fingerprint ignores comments and whitespace, so an entry survives unrelated edits and goes stale exactly when the code it is about changes; `--check` then fails on it (ticket 0093). A survivor no test reaches is a gap, not an entry here (CONVENTIONS T5).
lib/lapack/base/zsyr/lib/base.js#6649717: Lower branch, `j < N` -> `j <= N`: the extra pass j = N runs the inner loop `for ( i = j; i < N; ... )` zero times, so it writes nothing; it only reads x[N] into the locals tempR/tempI and advances jx, none of which is used after the loop.
lib/blas/base/dscal/lib/base.js#68a1c9f6: `N <= 0` -> `N < 0`: at N = 0 the unit-stride path has m = 0, skips the remainder loop and returns at `N < M`; the strided loop runs zero times. Either way x is returned unchanged, as the quick return does.
lib/blas/base/dscal/lib/base.js#2ed7b817: `m > 0` -> `m >= 0`: the extra case m = 0 enters a loop `for ( i = 0; i < m; ... )` that runs zero times.
lib/blas/base/zdotu/lib/base.js#68a1c9f6: `N <= 0` -> `N < 0`: at N = 0 the loop runs zero times and the function returns Complex128( tempR, tempI ) with both still 0.0, the quick return's value.
lib/blas/base/zaxpy/lib/base.js#68a1c9f6: `N <= 0` -> `N < 0`: at N = 0 the code past the quick return only reads alpha, takes reinterpret views and runs a loop `i < N` zero times, so y is returned unchanged, as the quick return does.
